summary: Extensions connect routing evidence to authority, uncertainty, and production feedback.

items.text: Separate capability from authority: a model that drafts excellent SQL may still be prohibited from seeing production data or executing a query.
Use a cascade with explicit escalation: start with the least costly approved model, escalate on low confidence, failed validators, disagreement, or high-risk task attributes.
Maintain shadow evaluations on sampled production inputs and require statistical and incident review before promoting a new model or router policy.
Expose a machine-readable routing explanation containing task class, policy version, considered models, binding constraints, and the evidence record that authorized the choice.
